conclusion.ordinaryInventory: The inspected ordinary MDVx inventory does not project or retain a physical-file Duration. MDB enrichment omits duration/length reads, row model has no count-plus-clock/duration field, and table/string export has no Duration branch.
conclusion.MDBDurationOwnerAndRule: Not applicable: no physical descriptor-length, file component-length or master clip-length selection for Duration exists in this traced enrichment route. MDVx supplies no duration-priority or missing-value formatting rule to copy.
conclusion.ratesNotDuration: Its stored frame-rate/sample-rate pairs are rates or previously noted numeric intermediates, not durations. No retained duration count is divided by them to produce a Duration cell in these paths.
conclusion.datesNotDuration: DB_Date and DB_Date_String are NSDate/date-time formatting. They are not file duration or SMPTE timecode.
conclusion.scope: Bounded to the inspected ordinary PMR/MDB inventory, row model/table/string-export and fallback row enrichment. Not a claim that embedded MXF libraries or every raw browser/private workflow cannot read a length or timecode.

actualDatabases.purpose: Independent read-only physical-file duration audit of six live MDBs and paired PMRs. No OldScanner output or media-header parsing used.
method: Current hashes are checked for six MDBs, six paired PMRs, six raw value indexes and the reused identity/PMR helper before interpretation.
Full normalized PMR FileMobId and MasterMobId select unique catalogue-qualified owners. Only exact file-owner PhysicalMedia target supplies the physical descriptor.

MDFL:Length is read as signed LE32 omfi:Long in these files, MDFL:SampleRate and PCMA:AudioSamplingRate as signed numerator/denominator LE32 ExactEditRate pairs. Raw count/rate and byte ranges are retained in examples.

Descriptor seconds are computed using exact Fraction(count * denominator, numerator) after nonnegative count and strictly positive numerator/denominator checks. Zero counts are reported separately, not silently treated as damage or missing.
PCMA base descriptor and AudioSamplingRate are compared separately. Channel count is recorded for context and never multiplies or divides duration.

Own file GroupLength/EditRate, own SCLP ClipLength/EditRate, selected-master GroupLength/EditRate and its SCLPs targeting the exact physical FileMobId are separate comparisons, never duration authorities. Component traversal stays within the owner and known wrappers; it does not follow SourceID into other mobs.
All reference-array/MobIndex counts must exactly equal parsed entries. Missing/unsupported/conflicting scalar fields and malformed refs are reported.

AIFD/WAVD summary presence is counted without parsing payloads because descriptor Length/SampleRate supplies a complete pair. Exact optional _AMD_SOURCE_LENGTH name occurrence is checked across the entire MDB.
No source path/filename/private text is copied into findings and no media essence/header is opened.
limits: Observed files are the six established littleendian legacy Bento/OMF layouts. No general MDB64/other-endian layout approval follows from this audit.
Matching database duration values establish internal consistency, not independent validation against physical essence. Header capabilities and source precedence remain separate decisions.

Zero/negative counts, invalid/nonpositive rates, missing descriptors, unsupported extended lengths, and source-length override may be unexercised; absence in this corpus does not define their Bella handling.
Selected-master counts are scoped by MDB and owner, not globally deduplicated MasterMobIds.
No runtime traversal, extra header-read trigger, display rounding or source-priority rule is approved by this research.
actualDatabases.curationScope: All per-database counts, types, rates and bounds retained. Replace bulk repeated raw examples with six representative owner-qualified examples; original full findings/probe are hashed outside repository.

proposedBellaRule.status: Source/valuepreservation, nativevideo interpreter andsixformatteraccuracy/displayrules agreed. Metadata qualification/layout andotherremainingdetails underreview; no runtimecode.
proposedBellaRule.source: Exact full-ID, catalogue-qualified physical file -> own safely resolved descriptor -> paired OMFI:MDFL:Length and OMFI:MDFL:SampleRate.
proposedBellaRule.count: Retain full source count in signed64 internal integer. Parse only explicitly supported typed wire forms; general extended-layout coverage remains to be established.
proposedBellaRule.rate: Retain original positive signed32 numerator and denominator and typed owner meaning. Approved interpreter derives the timing fraction via the exact scoped native mappings without overwriting source words.
proposedBellaRule.elapsedSeconds: Length * effective timing denominator / effective timing numerator after the approved scoped Avid video interpretation. Raw stored-fraction comparisons remain historical arithmetic, not the final timing rule for recognised aliases.
proposedBellaRule.zero: A correctly storedzero is known and displays00:00:00:00. Do not use zero as missing/unreadable default. No zero fixture occurred in the original corpus.
proposedBellaRule.unavailable: Agreed blankDurationcell forunavailable; retainphysicalrow. Kindunknown label remains a separatefieldrule.
proposedBellaRule.notOtherLengths: No master/group/clip/source ancestry length substitutes or cross-check graph merely for physical Duration. Do not reject full-ID matches because spans differ.
proposedBellaRule.concreteAudioRate: Separate Sample Rate field; the proposed duration divisor remains the recorded MDFL clock. Native PCMA playback preference for concrete audio rate is documented separately and is not a claimed native fallback rule.
proposedBellaRule.unverifiedAttribute: _AMD_SOURCE_LENGTH remains research, not a proposed release-one duration source.
proposedBellaRule.retention: Selected exact count/rate, source/unit meaning and compact availability. No retained raw descriptor, master length candidates, comparison graph or per-row formatted string solely for Duration.
proposedBellaRule.presentation: RequiredHH:MM:SS:FF, exactarithmetic, nominalbasesonlyfornumbering, qualifiedrecordedDF, preservedaudiosamples, zero/blank andno24hwrap agreed. Audio displayclocksource/nativeinterpretation andqualifiedDFbinding/fallback remainunderreview.
proposedBellaRule.deferred: MDB/extended64 layouts, generaldamage, audio display-clocksource/interpretation, qualifiedDFownerpath/fallback, sorting andCSV. Otherfields header policiesremainpending; DurationstaysMDB-only.
proposedBellaRule.unchanged: Exact six-tag Kind lookup, prior ID/Project/Original Bin/physical-path rules, requirements-first staging and Bin Filter remain unchanged.
